questions.question: Which statement is an outcome rather than an output?
options: Identify the failing service within two minutes while remaining read-only
questions.explanation: The statement names an observable change and constraint without fixing the artifact.

questions.question: Why does faster implementation increase shaping risk?
options: Teams can commit to the wrong problem before learning catches up
questions.explanation: Speed amplifies the cost of an unearned direction.

questions.question: What belongs in an outcome frame?
options: User, situation, current behavior, desired outcome, constraints, and non-goals
questions.explanation: The six surfaces connect the build to a real situation and boundary.

questions.question: When may an outcome frame name technology?
options: When a verified compatibility constraint truly fixes it
questions.explanation: Technology belongs only when evidence makes it a real constraint.

questions.question: What is the role of non-goals?
options: Reject tempting adjacent work in this slice
questions.explanation: Concrete non-goals keep the build attached to its current outcome.

questions.question: When has a constrained outcome failed?
options: When the desired result is reached by violating a fixed constraint
questions.explanation: Constraints are part of the outcome, not optional implementation guidance.
